title: spring-fleet configuration
description: Environment description for a fleet of multi-repo Spring Boot microservices. This file is private and must never be committed (see .gitignore).

reposRoot.description: Absolute path to the directory containing all service and shared-lib repos.

moduleFlag.description: Template for building/running a single module. {module} is replaced by the module path. e.g. gradle: '-p {module}', maven: '-pl {module}'.

run.description: Task/goal to run a service locally. e.g. 'bootRun' or 'spring-boot:run'.

logDir.description: Absolute path to the directory where service logs are collected. One <service>.log per service.

traceKeys.description: MDC keys that propagate across services and identify a single request/session. Order matters: the first key is the default correlation key. Recommended (2026): ['trace_id','span_id','sessionId','requestId'] — trace_id/span_id are the Micrometer Observation / OpenTelemetry conventions (W3C traceparent, 32-hex / 16-hex lowercase), and sessionId/requestId are kept as legacy fallback.

proxyLib.description: Name of the generated inter-service client library (if any), used to follow service-to-service calls during tracing.

name.description: Short logical name, also used as the log file base name.

logFile.description: Log file name within logDir. Defaults to <name>.log.

entry.description: Service names that receive external requests.

edges.description: Directed [from, to] service-name pairs describing who calls whom.
